_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY. Copy to experiment_config.json to run anything.
The real file ships ABSENT on purpose: an absent config is a refusal.
experiment_config.json is listed in this directory's .gitignore and must
NEVER be committed -- AR1 committed its operator-local copy by accident and
AR2 does not repeat that mistake.
No credential and no endpoint value belongs in this file. The endpoint is
read from the named environment variable at run time and is never recorded.
The broker pipe name, capability id and token appear nowhere in config: AIDO
generates them per run and delivers them only through the generated,
